source.reference: Stale-cache-after-write: a pre-existing write path left bypassing a newly added cache layer

defect: A pre-existing admin write path, outside both of the change's nodes and untouched by the diff, still writes through the raw store client after a write-through cache is added in front of it, so it never invalidates the cache and can leave a stale read live.
why_it_is_hard: Each node's own diff is correct and its own test passes reviewed alone: the cache layer invalidates on its own writes (ac_1), and the ordinary write path is routed through it (ac_2). The omission is a file neither node's paths name and the diff never touches — visible only by reading the whole diff together with the unmodified tree around it.
notes: Exercises per-node review (D-107, SCP-328): node_cache and node_write each look complete when reviewed alone against their own criterion, and the cross-node omission is visible only to the overall review, which reads the whole change. Paired with ver-010 as SCP-328's second graph-shaped fixture, exercising the opposite direction — a defect only a node-scoped review is likely to notice.
